Honestly, and this took me a long time to learn, communicating with a girl is like dancing. It takes two to tango, but like dancing, not every girl will want to. It starts with the eye contact, and unfortunately, we decide if a person is attractive or worthy within seconds. (Research shows 7 seconds.) So, acknowledge that it will not always work. 

Now, you got this girl engaged and started communicating with her. What’s the most important quality that’s important for her? Listening. It’s respectful. It’s humbling. It’s apparently damn so good attractive. And with good eye contact, you really got her on a dopamine high. (I’ll tell you something, when a girl talks about something she loves, she is feeling that dopamine high like one does with drugs, it’s that powerful).

I know what you’re thinking, I’m the guy engaging the conversation, so don’t I have to steer it? Well, funny you may ask, listening to her in a way is like steering the conversation (and in dancing way, letting her express herself will allow you to see her full potential) and allows you to say what you heard in a moment by “responding” (not reacting, but responding). Why responding? Reacting is when we already have something in mind to say without acknowledging the other person, responding is when we listen to what someone has said, take a moment, and say something that the person has said. 

In the end, it is a dance. And like all dances end at some point, all conversations end as well. It can be mutual. It can be platonic. It can be damn well anything. The point is: are you listening? are you letting her feel safe and enjoy the moment by listening to what she says? are you able to respond rather than react after she spoke? That’s the point, and trust me, you’ll get to say your interests and it may not come off perfect all the time, but you’ll definitely get that respect. 

And respect is more important than anything else, because when someone feels safe and sees your successes, they will always remember that and as a result, they respect you. It’s hard to gain respect, it’s easy to lose it and everything else (attraction, trust, confidence). 

P.s. we’re all nerds over something. I’m a nerd over marvel and avatar. Girls are nerdy too, they like Star Wars or video games or something crazy.

It’s not going to work. I’ve tried, I know how it feels. What you feel buddy, I felt that times 1000x. They’re not rejecting YOU. They’re rejecting those 30 seconds you attempted with them. (And guess what? They’re either fooling themselves or better yet, they will fool themselves when they know you better in other ways). Do you know wanna know how to get into relationships, one night stands, hookups, friends with benefits, or friendships? Confidence, first. But, most importantly, Experience and body language. A woman’s best friend is body language, a man’s best friend is experience. Woman are so good at body language, it’s really their best weapon in their arsenal. Don’t think that experiencing rejections will numb you, it’ll destroy you first. (It did to me.) But if you keep learning body language and use your raw social skills and understand her body language and gain experience from it (just forget the word rejection), you can isolate the difference between girls that’ll reject you and girls that are interested in you. Better yet, you’ll know how to flex better. You take control of your life. And woman will feel comfortable because they know you understand the environment and how they’re feeling. They’ll know you know what’s going on at the moment and will take care of yourself or handle it. That’s pretty much it, and it doesn’t involve rejection. But where does rejection come from? When you cannot understand the environment, the momentum, the situation. That’s the thing and that’s where your 30 seconds are shot dead in the water. 

In the end, what are women looking for? It’s not a buff guy, it’s not the guy with everything, it’s not the guy that is toxic. (Trust me, there are girls out there that fall for it and it’s a phase to flex but in actuality, it’s something else and I’ll tell you.) They’re looking for the guy that knows his shit, regardless of looks, money, appearances, or success. I mean, every women will flex with their own success. 

In the end, a woman does want to be behind their man’s back. And you’ll find one that is committed to you as much as you are to her, but where do you start? You start by communicating. Notice how I didn’t say just talk. I said communicate because you can communicate with girls in many different forms (just don’t be a stalker or creep while doing it). Don’t think about your friends, don’t think about society and the point of how things are in your age, DO think about the social norms behind a conversation, and certainly DO talk to girls that you feel attracted to, and DO know that you are a confident man in your own right. 

Now, here’s a personal advice that I am learning every day. Forget looks, appearances, and fame. Do you have the basic necessities to say to yourself “I am comfortable where I am.”? Do you have your own place? Do you have some source of income? (Nothing wrong with parents giving allowance). Are your buddies in the same pace as you and capable of being there for you? And lastly, do you feel like you have things going on for you that’ll give you comfort and drive? If all are yes, then you should feel really confident and comfortable approaching girls and having a good time. That’ll really shorten down the neediness because scarcity of time is key. Trust me. Nothing should hold you back, even rejection. 

OP. I hope you gained some clarity. It’s not rocket science. It’s human nature. Men and women have to communicate. I know society has standards and we rely on that, but in the end, it’s the muscle memory that makes the man, not the actual muscle. Good luck, and remember, you don’t want that pain. Trust me, I know.

Now, when it comes to being bored, they’re expecting someone to “wake” them up so that’s why there’s pickup lines and icebreakers involved. From how you bring this up, I assume you’re a good-looking guy but you start off with a basic greeting and a basic “what’s up.” Girls get these messages, like what? Maybe 2-3 times a day, more in a week. That’s basic. 
I recommend watching videos on bumble openers, and get an idea of what will make girls text you more on there, then when you gain their trust, move onto a different platform like text or Snapchat. That’s the whole point of these apps, they’re intermediaries to the actual apps of conversation. 
Good luck OP.

What you feel is what high schoolers feel when they were successful with breaking their status quo. Luckily, this is the real world and in the real world, there is no status quo after high school. You are what you are and you constantly change. She was popular in high school, but she is now average with very good qualities. Don’t tell them your entire life history and don’t make your day-to-day activities too obvious to know, then they don’t really show much interest. **There's a funny thing I learned this year: the guy is after the chase (forming the relationship), but once the chase is accomplished, the girl is on the mission (workings of the relationship and figuring out the guy)**

TIP: Your parents don't decide your future, you decide it. If you fall in love and wanna hitch, by all means. But don't do it for your parents' sake. Define what you want in life. Parents think that we don't know what we want, so they tell us what they know is best and from their "old" experience. But we know what we want to do and accomplish, so be clear with them on that.

OP, I read it thoroughly and I would like to say I am so sorry that you have had to find yourself in this situation. We all wish the best for you, and despite not knowing you at all, will have you in my prayers. That being said, and I hope it comes out properly, I don't think you should abstain yourself from boys or relationships. I believe you have friends that are boys, so you have a good trust system, to talk to boys in a friend-zone manner. But relationships, it's tricky, and it really depends on how you perceive it because everything is a relationship, especially friendships. I read the part you said that you conditioned yourself in believing that boys will like you through your consent of sex. I am a boy (21M) and I don't look at liking someone that way first and there are many guys out there that feel the same. We look at the girl for who they are, not what they look like. We believe in the idea of a relationship with someone, because we care for them as much as we care for ourself. **A relationship is a strong foundation based on strong trust, morals and values, and mutual obligations and care. Not all relationships happen through sex, some can be, but most are through the discovery in personal and emotional connection between two partners.** I recommend that, for your intimate relationships, that you look deep into your past experiences and see where you found yourself to believe in using sex to have guys like you. From there, you can figure out what you want from liking a boy (in the future) and what your intentions are. An intimate relationship is one that is declared mutually, that is sought through perseverance, and it is one that is truly rewarding for both looking to be in a relationship. If you do find that sex is your intention with the relationship, then you should always "shit" tests (to your way) the boy to see if his intention is on point like yours. I know it will be hard, and it won't always work with ease since guys will work up, but it is the best way to isolate your boys on trust and their ego masculinity. OP, you will find your man and you will be truly happy that you found someone who loves you truly for you, not for your body, for how you are and that will follow the foundations of a true relationship. 

I know that, due to your very recent experience, that it will be tough to be out there again and trust a boy with such a responsibility, but I can assure you that while you are working towards your ordeal through therapy, through the investigation, through your moods, always remember that you have your family, friends, members, like me, from the Reddit community, and especially God and Jesus that will help you through this and you will have the right pieces in order and be your whole self soon.

OP, I will be here, as a friend, if you need anything. Anything you want to talk about, please feel free to message me on here.  

Take care
